generating_model: Binomial-logit mixed model with measured genotype, sex and saved LOCO K; rejection sampling conditional on observed case count
effect_allele: Source analytical ALT; illustrative effect grid, not historical effect directions
representative_selection: Deterministic SHA256 rank among measured MAF-eligible markers, without consulting association p-values

pilot.scope: First retained LR historical target and one primary measured GWAS representative in each breed

intercept: Recenter once per effect/variance scenario to the observed expected case count by Gauss-Hermite integration; then condition complete draws on that case count
thresholds: Nominal 0.05, original conservative targeted 0.05/(18*2), or current within-breed reporting cutoff as applicable
interpretation: Power/calibration conditional on this finite cohort and stated generating model; not observed-effect post hoc power, not extreme-tail validation

analytical_benchmark.assumption: Independent HWE controls, rare-outcome approximation; case allele frequency obtained by odds weighting control genotypes; asymptotic allele-frequency test
